title: Every second item
prompt: Return a new array with the items at positions 0, 2, 4 and so on.
hints: range can take a step: range(0, size, 2).

docs.name: for i in range(n):
docs.what: Runs the indented lines with i counting 0, 1, 2 and so on.

docs.name: range(start, stop, step)
docs.what: Counts from start toward stop, moving by step each time.

docs.name: list[i]
docs.what: The item at position i. Positions start at 0; -1 is the last item.
